Single dad here on a throwaway to protect the guilty. When I got home from work today I knew something was off right away because there were two piles of puke on the floor. edit: Update. I woke her up at a reasonable hour and asked her if her head hurt and if she wanted an Advil, but she said she was fine now. I made us a nice breakfast and asked her why she did it. Her answer was that she just wanted to try it to see what it was about. I told her that if she wanted to try it she could have just asked me and I would have said yes, and that seemed to be a big 'aha' moment for her. I did confiscate her laptop though, and I plan to keep it for a week. She can still get to Netflix on her wii so she's not completely cut off from the internet.
